dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: Man, it's hard to tell what time it is in this place without a view of the scenery outdoors to take cues from...

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: *sigh* Humans relax much more easily when they're surrounded by nature.

dialogues.speaker: Ifa
dialogues.text: So, don't stay cooped up in here forever, okay? You gotta go get some air once in a while.
